dhikrList.name: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
dhikrList.source: Sahih Muslim 596 — 33x after each obligatory prayer

dhikrList.name: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
dhikrList.source: Sahih Muslim 596 — 33x after each obligatory prayer

dhikrList.name: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
dhikrList.source: Sahih Muslim 596 — 34x after each obligatory prayer, completing the 100

dhikrList.name: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير
dhikrList.transliteration: La ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulku wa lahul hamd, wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir
dhikrList.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and praise, and He is over all things Omnipotent
dhikrList.source: Sahih al-Bukhari 6403, Sahih Muslim 2691 — 100x a day

dhikrList.name: أستغفر الله
dhikrList.source: Sahih Muslim 2702 — the Prophet ﷺ sought forgiveness 100x a day

dhikrList.name: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
dhikrList.translation: Glory be to Allah, and praise Him

dhikrList.name: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
dhikrList.transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala aali Muhammad
dhikrList.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad
dhikrList.source: No authentic hadith fixes a specific number — recite it as often as possible

dhikrList.name: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
dhikrList.transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
dhikrList.translation: There is no power nor might except with Allah
dhikrList.source: No authentic hadith fixes a specific number — described as a "treasure of Paradise" (Sahih al-Bukhari 4205, Sahih Muslim 2704); recite it often
